extraction.Name: John Little Sun, (Robert Peters)
extraction.Buyer: Sold to C. E. Van dervoort for $5000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: It seems that the allottee was forced to sell his land to pay off mortgage, which had about two years to run.
extraction.Occupation/Income: income of about $15 per year from inherited land; Shares in Pawnee annuity
extraction.NOTES: Date and manner of delivery of patent Dec. 26, 1917, Agency office; receipted for: yes; mortgage not released or foreclosed, date of redemption not expired; did not owe purchaser anything; no land sold for debt or taxes; no contributions of any kind from Government or State or County; good health; no property or money accumulated; wife and one child dependent; allottee says the same land sold for more money a little later on; notarized November 26, 1928, County of Pawnee, State of Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929
